title: How to Seriously Level Up Your Faith Game
paragraphs: §Growing in Faith

Hey, what's up! It's your boy Simon Peter, one of Jesus's main guys, a real apostle. I'm writing this letter to all of you who have a faith that's just as legit as ours. You got it the same way we did: because our God and Savior, Jesus Christ, is totally fair and hooked you up. I'm praying that you get a massive dose of grace and peace as you get to know God and our leader, Jesus, even better.

God, in his insane power, has given us literally everything we need to live a life that's all about him. We got all this stuff by getting to know the guy who called us to be part of his own awesome glory and goodness. He gave us these super legit and precious promises, so that you could actually share in God's own nature. This is your ticket to escape all the toxic stuff in the world that comes from wanting the wrong things.

So, because of all that, you gotta work hard to build on your faith. Don't just stop at faith. Add to it some real goodness. To that goodness, add knowledge. To that knowledge, add self-control. To that self-control, add patience. To that patience, add a real respect for God. To that respect for God, add kindness to your fellow believers. And to all of that, add love. If you're growing in these things, it proves you're not just sitting around doing nothing. It shows that your knowledge of our Master Jesus Christ is actually making a difference. But if you don't have these things, you're basically blind. You've forgotten that you were cleaned up from all your old sins.

So, my friends, you gotta be extra sure that God really did call you and choose you. If you live like this, you'll never stumble and fall. You'll get a main entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. That's a promise.

That's why I'm always going to remind you of this stuff, even though you already know it and are solid in the truth you have. I think it's the right thing to do to keep bugging you about it as long as I'm alive. I know I'm going to die soon, Jesus himself made that crystal clear to me. So I'm making a huge effort to make sure that after I'm gone, you'll always be able to remember these things.

Listen, we weren't just telling you some made-up fairy tales when we talked about the powerful return of our Master, Jesus Christ. We were eyewitnesses to his majesty. We were there when he received honor and glory from God the Father. The voice from the Majestic Glory, God himself, said, "This is my Son, who I love. I am super pleased with him." We heard that voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

And that makes the message of the prophets even more certain for us. You need to pay close attention to that message. It's like a light shining in a dark place, until the day comes and the Morning Star, Jesus, rises in your hearts. Most importantly, you have to understand that no prophecy in Scripture is just some guy's personal opinion. Because prophecy never came from what a human wanted to say. Instead, the Holy Spirit moved men to speak God's words.

title: Watch Out for the Fakes
paragraphs: §False Teachers

Back in the day, there were a bunch of fake prophets running around, and guess what? It's happening again. You've got these phony spiritual gurus who show up and start stirring up drama, creating cliques and turning everyone against each other. They totally diss the God who gave them a second chance, and they're on a fast track to a major crash and burn. But first, they gather a crew of confused followers who can't even tell what's real anymore.

These guys make the truth look bad because they're just in it for themselves. They'll say whatever sounds good to play you and use you for their own gain. But don't worry, they won't get away with it. Karma is coming for them, because God has never been cool with that kind of behavior.

Think about it: God didn't let the rebel angels off the hook. He locked them up in the underworld to wait for the final showdown. He hit the reset button on the whole ancient world with a massive flood, and only saved eight people, including Noah, who was the only one keeping it real. He completely wrecked the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, leaving nothing but ashes as a serious heads-up to anyone thinking about living a messed-up life. But he did rescue Lot, a good guy who was about to lose his mind from all the toxic, twisted stuff going on around him. That guy was in constant agony, seeing all the moral rot day in and day out.
So yeah, God knows how to get his people out of tough spots. And he definitely knows how to make the wicked face the music when Judgment Day comes.

God is especially not cool with these so-called "teachers" who are just slaves to their own horrible desires. They hate it when anyone with real authority calls them out. They're just a bunch of arrogant fools who talk trash about awesome spiritual beings. Even angels, who are way more powerful, wouldn't dare to bad-mouth others like that in front of God.

These people are basically like wild animals, just predators looking for someone to tear down. They spout a bunch of ignorant, disrespectful nonsense, and in the end, they're the ones who will get wrecked. All their negativity will boomerang right back and hit them. They're so into their own pleasure that they party hard in broad daylight. They're obsessed with cheating and sinning, and they prey on anyone who's new and vulnerable. They're experts at being greedy. They're spiritually dead.

They've wandered way off the right path and are totally lost. They're just like that old prophet Balaam, who sold out for money and was all about evil. But even he got called out when his own donkey started talking and stopped him from doing something crazy.

These fakes are like dried-up wells or clouds in a storm—totally empty and useless, headed for a black hole. They talk a big game, but it's all hot air. Still, they're dangerous. People who just escaped a messed-up life are the most likely to fall for their tricks. They promise freedom, but they're the ones who are slaves to their own corruption. If you're addicted to something, you're its slave.

If people have escaped the garbage dump of sin by getting to know our Master and Savior, Jesus Christ, and then they slide right back into that same old life, they're in worse shape than before. It would have been better to never even start on the right path than to start, and then turn your back on the holy mission you were given. It just proves those old sayings are true: "A dog goes back to its own vomit," and "A pig that gets a bath will head right back to the mud."

title: The Day the World Gets Wrecked
paragraphs: §The Day of the Lord

Hey, what's up guys. This is the second letter I'm sending your way. I'm writing this to make sure you're staying focused and not getting distracted. Don't forget what the OG prophets told you, and the big command from our Lord and Savior that his crew, the apostles, passed down to you.

First things first, you gotta know that in the final days, a bunch of haters are gonna show up and just roast everything. They're gonna be all like, "LOL, so where's this big 'comeback' he promised? Our grandparents are long gone, and everything's still the same as it was since the world began. Nothing's changed, bro."

These guys totally forget that way back, God created the entire universe and our planet out of a watery mess just by saying the word. Then, He did it again and brought a massive flood that wiped everything out. The world we're living in now? It's basically just fuel for a giant bonfire at the end of time. God's just waiting to give the signal to light it all up and wreck all the fakers and haters.

But don't get it twisted, my friends. For God, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years is like a day. He's not running late on his promise, like some people think. He's actually holding back for you guys, because he doesn't want anyone to be lost. He's giving everyone a chance to get their act together and have a miraculous transformation.

But when God's judgment day finally hits, it's gonna come out of nowhere, like a thief in the night. The sky will straight up collapse with a huge bang, and everything will get vaporized in a massive fire. The earth and everything on it will be put on blast for everyone to see.

Since everything we know could be gone tomorrow, you see why it's so important to live a good and holy life, right? You should be hyped for God's big day, waiting for it to arrive. The whole universe is gonna burn up and melt down, but we'll be looking forward to the new and improved heavens and earth that he promised, a place that's totally righteous.

So, my guys, since this is what you're looking forward to, you better be on your best behavior, living a pure and peaceful life. And when you see God being patient, know that it's because he's giving everyone a chance to be saved. Our boy Paul, who's super wise about this stuff, wrote about it in his letters to you. Some of the stuff he writes is kinda hard to get, and some clueless people who don't know what they're talking about twist his words all around. They do the same thing with the rest of the Bible, and they're just wrecking themselves.
But you guys have been warned. So be on guard, and don't let these fake teachers trip you up and make you lose your way. Keep growing in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
All glory to the King, now and forever! Let's go!
